chicut: chik'ut — again then, one more then; chik 'again' + k'ut 'then' written as one word, the c shared

abixic: ab'ixik — field work, working a field; ab'ix 'maize field' made a verb + -ik

ruꜭ: ruk' — with him/it; relational noun r- 'its/his' + uk' 'company'
catoh: q'atoj — cut, cutting; the word is certain, written with plain c (Brasseur gatoh), the toggle restores the q'

xcam: xkam — he died; x- completive + kam 'die' · xk'am — they took, he took; x- completive + k'am 'take'

cupuh: kupuj — (inferred) clearing, pulling up; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'ce que la pioche arrachait'; respelled by the letters
puch: puch — also, and; particle tagging the second of a pair
ca: qa — we, our; qa- 'our' or 'we' before a verb · ka — (uncertain) in que ka k'o, 'there will yet be'; k- 'ongoing' + a · ka — k- 'ongoing' before a verb or state word, written apart (ka pichipoj '(they) are pichipoj', uncertain; ma ka jisaj, k- + a- 'you') · ka — second (inferred); kab' 'second' written without its b', as uka 'a second (pit)' · ka — (unclear) a particle before a verb or a word of state, left unrendered

cabix: kab'ix — their field; ki- 'their' (c- before a vowel) + ab'ix · qab'ix — our field; qa- 'our' + ab'ix, the same letters
na: na — now, then; particle · na — still; particle · na — feeling, sense (inferred); na 'feel', the root of nao · na — (inferred) first, for the time being; as in oh na 'we first'
bano: b'ano — do, make; b'an 'do, make' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xki b'ano 'they made it')
vlo: ulo — hither; short form of uloq
la: la — unexplained particle in kat kix la uloq; uncertain · la — you, Your Lordship, a respectful form (chi la 'to you'; inferred from Brasseur's note); particle · la — (uncertain) kept apart from pis 'wrap' (chi ki pis la ki wi' 'they wrapped their heads', after Brasseur); not clear
xeꜭha: xech'a — they spoke; x- completive + e- 'they' + ch'a(w) 'speak'
cut: k'ut — then, and so; narrative connective particle

opon: opon — arrive (there); verb, arriving at a place away from the speaker (ul is 'arrive here')
ha: ja' — water; noun · ja — house (modern ja; que rah acanic chuvi ha 'they want to climb on the house') · ja — go! (a command, inferred, after Brasseur)
naqui: naqi — what; interrogative, written with pa as naqi pa 'what is it'
lo: lo — perhaps; particle, as in k'o wi lo · saw (uncertain), in xki lo 'they saw it'; a verb not otherwise known, sense inferred from Brasseur
coh: koj — we, us (shall); k- 'shall' + oj 'we, us', before a verb (koj isik'ij 'you shall call on us') · koj — we, us (ongoing); k- 'ongoing' + oj 'we, us' (coh icuxih 'you chased us') · koj — put, place; transitive verb (inferred) · koj — (inferred) puma; noun, as ꜭoh (Brasseur 'Lion'), written with plain c and the same letters as koj 'we'

catit: qatit — our grandmother; qa- 'our' + atit 'grandmother' · katit — their grandmother; k- (ki- 'their' before a vowel) + atit 'grandmother', in the narrative (ruk' katit 'to their grandmother')

xoh: xoj — we, us (completed action); x- completive + oj 'we, us', the absolutive, before the verb (xoh camic 'we died')
chire: chire — to him, to her; chi + r- 'him/her' + e · chire — at his teeth (inferred); chi + r- 'his' + e 'tooth' · chire — because, for; conjunction (chire lib'ajchi 'because quickly')
pu: pu — also, and; short form of puch · pu — in, at (inferred); pa 'in', in pu chi' 'in the mouth' · pu — in its, in the; pa 'in' + u- 'its' contracted (Brasseur: pu for pa u, p'u 'dans le'), as pu b'eal 'by the road', pu wi' ja 'in the top of the house'
xcoh: xkoj — we shall; x(c)- 'shall' + oj 'we', before a verb
be: b'e — road, path; noun · b'e — go (chi b'e 'that we go'); verb, the root of xb'e 'he went'
xchi: xchi — shall; the future prefix xchi-, written apart before the person prefix and the verb
rumal: rumal — by, because of, through; relational noun r- 'its' + umal 'cause, agent'
ban: b'an — do, make; root of the verb, here with x- completive and ki- 3pl: 'they did'
chique: chike — to them; chi 'to' + ke 'them' · chiqe — to us (inside speech); chi + qe 'us' (Ximénez's qu stands for both k and q; the toggle shows chiqe) · chike — (guess) a verb after xe, 'leaned (?)', in xe chique chuvi 'they leaned (?) over it'; not clear; Brasseur 'se tournèrent … vers le parfum'

e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb · e — tooth, teeth; noun (also in we 'my teeth', re 'his teeth')

ronohel: ronojel — all, everything; quantifier, r- + onojel
are: are — this is, it is; demonstrative/copula pointing forward
vꜭux: Uk'u'x — its heart; u- 'its' + k'u'x 'heart, centre'; in Uk'u'x Kaj 'Heart of Sky'
acab: aq'ab' — night; written with plain c, where the house word is aꜫab; the toggle restores the q'

conohel: konojel — all of them; ki- 'their' made k- before a vowel + onojel, as ronojel is r- + onojel
caam: k'a'm — vine, creeper; noun, paired with che' 'tree'
que: ke — thus, as; adverb of manner · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'they', before a verb (xa ke wachelajik 'they kept on screeching') · qe — for us (uncertain); qa- 'our, us' set (tzuqul qe, k'o'l qe) · ke — of them (banol ke 'maker of them'), compare kech · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'them', the object before a transitive verb (ke qa chak 'we defeat them', qa- 'we') · qe — us (the object after an agent noun, camol qe 'taker of us'); q- 'we, us' + e

vach: wach — face (also eye, fruit); noun, root of uwach (ki wach 'their face')
v: u — its; possessive prefix (Ximénez writes v), as in v xe 'its root'

chapo: chapo — catch it; chap 'catch' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb
xu: xu — it (did); x- completive + u- 'it', singular of xki
ya: ya — give; verb (ku ya 'he gives') · ya — river, water (inferred, after Brasseur); noun, the letters respelled as written · ya — put, set; the 'give' verb used of placing a thing (qui ya 'they put it', chi ya chuvi ꜫaꜫ 'put it on the fire')
vmul: umul — rabbit, hare; noun, with u- part of the word
he: je — (inferred) go; a form of the verb 'go', after Brasseur, read with ho 'we go' and hix 'you go'; the person is unclear · je' — tail; noun (qui he 'their tails'), not the he 'go'
chap: chap — seize, catch; verb, the root of chapo and chapon
cab: q'ab' — hand, arm; noun, the same word as q'ab' written with plain c · kab' — second; kab' 'two', in u kab' 'its second' (v cab, written apart), as in the ordinal ukab' · kab' — two, a pair; in u kab' 'the two of them' (v cab, written apart), after Brasseur (inferred)
cam: k'am — take; verb · kam — die; verb
ma: ma — not, nor, or (in a question); negative/interrogative particle
vtiu: Utiw — Coyote; name element, in Junajpu Utiw 'Hunahpu Coyote' (u- here part of the name; tiw 'coyote'?) · utiw — coyote; noun, with u- part of the word, as in the name Junajpu Utiw (Brasseur 'Chacal')
aꜫ: aq' — peccary, wild pig; noun, with the tresillo (Brasseur ak 'Sanglier')
ziz: sis — (inferred) coati; Brasseur 'Porc-Epic'; written with z for s
icouic: ik'owik — passing; ik'ow 'pass' + -ik, the ending of an intransitive verb at the end of its clause

ꜭux: k'u'x — heart; noun (ki k'u'x 'their heart'); root of Uk'u'x
habi: jab'i — there was, there is; existential, as in ma jab'i 'there was not' (mahabi in the preamble)
xpe: xpe — it came; x- completive + pe 'come'
curi: k'uri — then, and so; k'u 'then' + ri, narrative connective
hunchic: junchik — one more; jun 'one' + chik 'again, more' · junchik — the other (are k'uri junchik 'and the other'); jun 'one' + chik

cho: cho — lake; noun, paired with palo 'sea'
catepuch: k'atepuch — then also; cate 'then' + puch 'also' written as one word
chirih: chirij — behind it; chi + r- 'its' + ij 'back', relational noun · chirij — (inferred) on, over (the surface of); chi + r- 'his' + ij 'back, surface' (chirij uwach 'on his face')
chuvi: chuwi' — on top of; chi + u- 'its' + wi' 'head, top', relational noun · chuwi' — (inferred) after, later (of time), in ka chuwi' chik 'later on'; after Brasseur ('ensuite de cela')
ꜫaꜫ: q'aq' — fire; noun (pa ꜫaꜫ 'in the fire') · q'aq' — red (Brasseur cak 'rouge'); the same tresillo letters as 'fire'; the modern word is kaq, the toggle respells the letters

vvach: uwach — its face; u- 'its' + wach 'face, surface', possessed noun · uwach — its fruit (the face a tree shows); noun
biye: b'iye — (inferred) going, journey; perhaps from b'e 'go' or b'in 'walk' (Brasseur 'leur voyage'); the reading of the last letter is doubtful
cumal: kumal — by them; r- 'by' form rumal with 3pl ki- · qumal — by us; r- 'by' form rumal with qa- 'we' (Brasseur kumal, his k is q)
ꜭaholab: k'ajolab' — boys, young men; k'ajol 'son, young man' + plural -ab'
camic: kamik — died, dying; cam 'die' + -ic (xoh camic 'we died')
ivumal: iwumal — by you (pl.); i- 'you (pl.)' + umal, the umal of rumal 'by, because of'
ipatan: ipatan — your service; i- 'your (pl.)' + patan 'service, duty, tribute'
ꜭo: k'o — there is, exists; existential verb
ive: iwe — you (pl.); iw- 'your (pl.)' + e, the form seen in chiwe 'to you'
xꜭha: xch'a — said; x- completive + ch'a 'say', the singular of xech'a
apa: apa — where; interrogative adverb, asks the place
bala: b'ala — unexplained (Brasseur 'at their ease'); uncertain · b'ala — here 'very well' after utz (Utz b'ala 'very well', after Brasseur 'C'est fort bien'); inferred · b'ala — (inferred) indeed; strengthens the word before it (qitzij b'ala 'truly indeed')
nu: nu — my; 1sg possessive · nu — I; ergative prefix before a verb (ka nu tao 'I hear it', ka nu riqo 'I find it')
pam: pam — belly, womb, inside; noun (cha pam 'in your belly', ꜭo chi nu pam 'in my belly')
chin: chin — I shall (inferred); ch- 'what is to come' + in 'I', before a verb
biyh: b'iyj — say, tell; the verb b'ij 'say' with its letters in another order, as in xchicabyih
chive: chiwe — to you, by you (pl.); chi + ive
yao: yao — give; ya 'give' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xu yao 'it gave')
avecha: awecha — your food; aw- 'your' before a vowel + echa 'food'
rech: rech — of it, for it; relational noun with r- 'its' + ech

vbi: ub'i' — its name, called; u- 'its' + b'i' 'name', possessed noun

rah: raj — want (to); r- 'his, its' + aj 'want', the form of xrah, apparently fixed after a plural subject (que rah 'they want to'), the wanted act following
ivatit: iwatit — your (pl.) grandmother; iw- 'your (pl.)' + atit 'grandmother, old woman'
nim: nim — great, big; adjective · nim — (inferred) respect, honour; nim 'great' made a noun or verb, in ki nim 'their respect'
xquicot: xkikot — they rejoiced; x- completive + root kikot 'be glad' · xkikot — they dug; x- completive + ki- 'they' + kot 'dig'
tao: tao — hear it; ta 'hear' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (ka nu tao 'I hear it')
recha: recha — his food; r- 'his' before a vowel + echa 'food'
zaquil: saqil — whiteness, light, clarity; saq 'white' + -il abstract noun
vve: uwe — if, whether; we 'if' written vv (Brasseur divides u ve); the first v is not explained (uncertain) · uwe — (inferred) yes, as a reply; the we 'yes' written vv (Brasseur Uve, 'C'est fort bien')
naquila: naqila — anything, something; indefinite pronoun · naqila — what (in a question, mi xki kulwachij 'what have they met'); same word as the indefinite
cha: cha — said, say; quotative root (uncertain in this phrase 'cha ta k'ut') · cha — at your; chi 'at' + a- 'your' (cha mox 'at your left', cha wi ki q'ab' 'at your right'), inferred · cha — (guess) arrow point, flint; after Brasseur's note (cha 'the word, the arrow, and the point of the arrow, obsidian or flint'), in xa kolokik cha 'only a round flint (?)' · cha — (inferred) blade, obsidian edge, as the arrow point above (chi cha 'of the blade') · cha — you (command); ch- + a- 'you' before a verb (cha coto 'you dig')
xuꜭhax: xuch'ax — he was told; x- completive + u- + ch'a 'say' + -x (passive), without its -ik
ꜩac: tzaq — fall; verb (que ꜩac vloc 'they fell down') · tzaq — drop, let fall; with qa- 'we', transitive · tzaq — (uncertain) in jun tzaq, jun b'it 'one tzaq, one shaped', echoing winaq tz'aq, winaq b'it; respelled as written · tzaq — (inferred) wall, building; with katanaj, after Brasseur 'à la terrasse de la maison'; respelled by the letters
a: a — your, you (one person); a- 'your' before a noun, a- 'you' before a verb · a — (inferred) river, water; after Brasseur (chi quiqi-a 'at the river of blood')
ꜭolic: k'olik — existing, being there; k'ol + -ik, positional/participle
huzu: jusuk — suddenly, at once; adverb (Ximénez's huzu is huzuc with its c shared with the next word cu)
xiquin: xikin — ear; noun (qa xikin 'our ear', inferred)
ho: jo — (inferred) we go, let us go; the verb 'go' (Brasseur names it Ho 'aller', with hin 'that I go', he 'that they go'); the person 'we' is inferred, the letters respelled
co: k'o — there is; existential verb (written co in k'o wi lo)
apanoc: apanoq — later, in time (guess); not otherwise known · apanoq — away, over there; apan 'go there' + -oq, after a verb of motion
cat: kat — you (one) shall; k- 'shall' + at 'you', singular of kix · kat — you (one), of what is going on; k- 'ongoing' + at 'you' (kat b'e 'you are going') · kat — (inferred) then, so; taken as k'ut written cat (keje' kat 'so then', Brasseur quehecut), the letters respelled · k'at — burn; verb (xk'at 'it burned'), the root of k'atanalaj 'burning hot'; not kat 'you (one)' · kat — carrying net (Brasseur 'filet'); noun, written with plain c, the same letters as kat 'you'
quil: kil — it is seen (inferred); il 'see' with k-, in xa k'o kil kakiye; not clear · kil — (inferred) hold back; in xqui quil quib 'they held one another back', after Brasseur ('defending themselves')
tum: tum — (guess) brambles; printed as read (once written tun, with two minims); sense after Brasseur 'ronces'
cah: kaj — sky (also 'four' in the cord passage); noun · qaj — we want; q- 'we' (before a vowel) + aj 'want', as xkaj 'they wanted' · qaj — go down, descend (inferred); verb, as in qajik 'descending' · kaj — (inferred) they want; k- (ki- 'they' before a vowel) + aj 'want', after chi of wishing (chi kaj ta 'let them be willing'); the same letters as qaj 'go down'

quih: kij — its juice (inferred); written qu + i as Brasseur's quih, not q'ij 'day'

va: wa — this; demonstrative · wa — food, the maize tortilla (ca va 'our food', modern wa)
ti: ti — (inferred) eat (flesh); verb, after Brasseur 'les mangeaient'
raih: raij — it wants, desire (inferred); r- + aij 'desire', as in rraij; after Brasseur ('convoite') · raij — want (inferred); with ka- 'you' (ca raih 'you want') and with nu- 'I' (ca nu raih 'I want it'), so the r belongs to the stem here; after Brasseur ('désires', 'j'en veux')

lac: laq — plate; noun (Aj Raxa Laq 'He of the Green Plate'; household plates)
vvaal: uwaal — its liquid, its water (inferred); u- 'its' + waal, the water of his mouth
re: re — of, belonging to; relational particle · re — his teeth; r- 'his' + e 'tooth'
quebal: keb'al — household things (inferred); not otherwise known
chaquih: chaqi'j — dry; adjective · chaqi'j — (inferred) dry (something), parch; used as a verb in xqui chaquih 'they dried it' over the fire (Brasseur 'jeté sur le feu') · chaqi'j — (guess) spend (the day) at something; in qui chaquih chi hutaquih, after Brasseur 'ils employaient tout le jour'
cama: kama — taking, take (inferred); from k'am 'take', perhaps with a nominal ending; the toggle respells the letters
quia: kia — (inferred) many; not otherwise known, after Brasseur ('of many different kinds')
ve: we — if, whether; conjunction · we — (uncertain) teeth, following Brasseur ('my teeth shine'), in nay pu ve raxcavacoh · we — yes; particle (Brasseur 'yes') · we — my teeth; w- 'my' + e 'tooth'
xbec: xb'ek — he went; x- completive + b'e 'go' + -k
xquil: xkil — they saw; x- completive + ki- 'they' + il 'see', without the -o of xkilo
chupan: chupam — inside, within; chi + u- 'its' + pam 'inside'
colon: kolon — safe, freed (inferred); taken from kol 'save'
vloc: uloq — hither, this way; adverb with verbs of coming
xquilo: xkilo — they saw (it); x- completive + ki- 'they' + il 'see' + -o, ending of a transitive verb · xqilo — we saw (it); x- completive + q- 'we' (the form of qa- before a vowel) + il 'see' + -o
tac: taq — plural marker 'various, several'; particle placed before a noun
xopon: xopon — he arrived; x- completive + opon 'arrive'
atit: atit — grandmother; noun (also in Ratit) · atit — old woman; noun
chel: chel — let it go out; el 'go out' with ch- optative
chuvach: chuwach — on the face of; chi + u- 'its' + wach 'face', relational noun
chu: chu — at, by its (before a noun); let it (before a verb); chi 'at' + u- 'its' (chu jutaq chob'il 'by each division'), or ch- 'let' + u- 'it' (chu riqo 'let it find') · chu — he, it, before a verb; ch- + u- 'he', without the sense 'let' (chu maijaj 'he marvels') · chu — (inferred) ch- + u-, singular, with plural doers named after the verb (are puch chu sik'ij ri ajsib', ajkot 'the painters and carvers call on them too')
naquipa: naqipa — what; naqi 'what' + pa, in naquipa rumal 'why, for what reason'
mi: mi — now, just now; particle, as mi- in mixutzinik · mi — (inferred) do not, before a verb (mi xb'isonik 'do not grieve', after Brasseur 'ne vous affligez pas'); the form is not clear
vbic: ub'ik — thither (inferred); an adverb of direction, with ok 'enter'
vla: ula — hither, coming; adverb with verbs of coming
xcah: xqaj — it went down; x- completive + qaj 'descend' · xkaj — they wanted; x- completive + k- (ki- 'they' before a vowel) + aj 'want', as in xraj 'he wanted'
ruc: ruk' — with; relational noun r- + uk' 'company', the same word as ruk' written with plain c
tah: taj — let it be, may it; Classical optative particle (in modern K'iche' taj is a negative) · taj — the second part of the negative ma ... taj 'not' (ma nab'e ki chakatajik taj 'not first their being brought low')
hom: jom — ball court; noun, the walled alley of the ball game (Brasseur: the hall of the ball game, Nahuatl tlachco)
tahin: tajin — be at it, busy; the progressive tajin 'in the act of', here ka tajin 'he is at it'
vvb: uub' — his blowgun; u- 'his' + ub' 'blowgun' · wub' — blowgun, after qa/ki (qa wub' 'our blowgun', ki wub' 'their blowgun'); the vv respelled wu, as iwub'aj; whether the v is a glide is not clear
xi: xi — x- completive + i(n) 'me', the absolutive object, with the n not written (inferred); written apart before the ergative prefix and verb
hunam: junam — alike, the same; jun 'one' + -am (inferred); Brasseur 'of the same kind'
quehecut: keje'k'ut — thus then; keje' + k'ut written as one word
